description.zh:
要操作的DDoS高防实例的ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeInstanceIds](~~157459~~)查询所有DDoS高防实例的ID信息。
description.en:
The ID of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance to manage.

> You can invoke [DescribeInstanceIds](~~157459~~) to query the IDs of all Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instances.

description.zh:
为DDoS高防实例设置备注。

支持使用中文字符、英文大小写字符、数字及部分特殊字符，例如：`,.+-*/_`。最长不允许超过500个字符。
description.en:
Settings for the remark of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance.

The remark can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, and some special characters such as `,.+-*/_`. The remark can be up to 500 characters in length.

title.zh: 修改指定实例的备注信息
title.en: Modify the remark of a specified instance

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddoscoo modify-instance-remark --instance-id ddoscoo-cn-mp91j1ao0000 --remark new-remark --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
